purpose: Make every daily lesson auditable and pedagogically intentional.

vocabularySelection.currentMethod: AI-curated for high-frequency conversational usefulness, roadmap relevance, natural reusable chunks, and spaced review. No item is claimed to be copied from a specific dictionary or corpus unless that day explicitly lists a reference.
priorities: fit with the current 90-day roadmap topic
spaced retrieval of previously learned language
avoid: rare words chosen only to look advanced
word-for-word Vietnamese mappings without usage context

referencePolicy.whenExternallyVerified: A daily item may list named dictionaries, learner references, corpora, authentic examples, or pronunciation references only after that source has actually been checked.
referencePolicy.rule: Do not fabricate citations or imply a specific source was consulted when it was not.
